title: Lighting
summary: The four light types on one light: point (all directions, power 400), sun (from infinitely far, parallel shadows, strength 1), spot (one direction: a cone that lights just the plate) and area (a window). Then the scene's lights: a warm point light at the back (3200 K, a bigger radius for softer shadows, higher up, lowered to a detail), an area light behind the donuts that is tried and deleted, and the main light: a spot near the camera but very high, aimed at the donuts, with its cone size and blend set for a pool of light; a dark world.

objects.name: Luz calida
objects.description: warm point light at the back

objects.name: Foco
objects.description: spot light high in front, aimed at the donuts

expected_result: A dark scene with a soft-edged pool of light on the plate and donuts from above the camera, and a warm glow from behind.

steps.note: Shift+A > Light > Point: light from one point in every direction; power 400
type Sun, strength 1: from the sky, parallel shadows
type Spot: one direction; R to aim it: only the plate is lit
type Area: light from a surface, like a window, only on one side
a point light at the back of the scene, higher up, power 5000, bigger radius for a softer shadow, 3200 K: orange
lowered: only a warm detail in the background, not the main light
the main light as an area light: behind the donuts (back half of the scene, the side away from the camera), big, aimed at the donuts
valid, but a bit dull: deleted
a spot near the camera but very high, aimed at the donuts (Shift+T), power up, cone size and blend: a pool of light
the background stays dark so the pool of light reads
